title: INC-1043 Authentication Gateway runbook
content: INC-1043 runbook for Authentication Gateway, last updated 2026-04-16T03:21:00Z. Symptom to identify: login and token refresh requests failed with TLS handshake errors. First verify the time window and inspect INC-1043-LOGS. Test competing hypotheses separately: a new identity provider policy rejecting old OAuth scopes; DNS propagation sending users to a retired gateway. Do not treat either as established without matching evidence. Diagnostic confirmation for this incident: openssl x509 reported notAfter=2026-04-16T02:00:00Z; gateway logs recorded certificate_expired for every failing handshake. If confirmed, apply recovery steps: issued and installed a replacement certificate, re-enabled the renewal service account, and added 30-day expiry alerts. Recheck customer-facing errors and record the resolution timestamp 2026-04-16T03:21:00Z. For causal analysis cite INC-1043-POSTMORTEM. Evidence source ID: INC-1043-RUNBOOK.
